title: From Admitted Distinctions to S(n) and MSS-N: Presentations, Retractions, and Obstruction
description: An admitted distinction raises two separate questions: how should it be represented, and which prior information must remain recoverable as the representation changes? This paper consolidates the S(n) presentation-tower account, the MSS-N mathematical monograph, and the corrected Pre-Genesis-through-MSS-N architectural walkthrough. It develops finite demand accounting, report sufficiency on the actual report image, typed recovery on an old image, and chain-map retraction limits on cycle repair. Standalone Lean constructions and executable Python test companions expose the assumptions and replay scope.
